blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Three unidentified men robbed a convenience store in Santa Rosa City, Laguna, early Wednesday, taking P10,000 in cash, police reported. The robbery occurred at 12:50 a.m. at a 7-Eleven minimart branch in Barangay Tagapo, according to the Calabarzon police.
